QUOTE: when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is not defined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`. ... The opt-out ... `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` ... sees the real member names.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States the default rename to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS exposes the real member names (the unchanged name).
